caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned object that appears to be a candlestick or candle holder, rendered in shades of deep reddish brown. The object has a wide, circular base that tapers upward and then expands into three bulbous, rounded segments stacked vertically, finishing with a narrower, slightly flared opening at the top. The item displays reflective highlights along its curves, indicating a glossy, possibly ceramic or glass surface. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or elements present. The artist's name, "JANET RIZA," is printed in small uppercase letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Candlestick
